title_en: Busan Port Authority Maritime Startup Idea Competition "Spark-Up 1876"
summary: The department is sharing an announcement from the Busan Port Authority about the maritime startup idea competition "Spark-Up 1876". The notice text gives no eligibility, deadlines or application method. These details appear to be in the attached PDF, which was not read for this translation.
conditions: The notice text states no eligibility rules, deadlines or application requirements. These may be in the attached PDF, which was not read.
